cd /root/autodl-tmp/event-gated-adaptive-horizon/ && python3 -c "
from tbparse import SummaryReader
import pandas as pd
r = SummaryReader('logdir/exp_001_baseline_s4/')
df = r.scalars
vm = df[df['tag']=='scalars/value_mean'][['step','value']].rename(columns={'value':'value_mean'})
er = df[df['tag']=='scalars/eval_return'][['step','value']].rename(columns={'value':'eval_return'})
merged = pd.merge(vm, er, on='step', how='inner')
merged['ve_ratio'] = merged['value_mean'] / merged['eval_return']
merged = merged.sort_values('step')
merged.to_csv('artifacts/exp_001_baseline_s4_ve_profile_full.csv', index=False)
print(f'Saved {len(merged)} rows')
print(f'Step range: {merged.step.min()} - {merged.step.max()}')
print('First 5 rows (step >= 35K):')
print(merged[merged.step >= 35000].head(5).to_string(index=False))
print('Last 5 rows:')
print(merged.tail(5).to_string(index=False))
"
